title: Director of Experiential Learning
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Experiential Learning serves as the strategic and
operational leader responsible for implementing, scaling, and
overseeing the university-wide Experiential Learning for All
initiative. This position collaborates across academic and
administrative units to develop centralized infrastructure,
establish systems and processes, implement quality measures, and
coordinate university-wide tracking to ensure equitable student
access while supporting college ownership of learning. The Director
also partners with internal and external stakeholders to integrate
high-impact experiential opportunities into degree requirements,
academic advising, career mentoring, and the broader Boldly Butler
strategic vision.

Responsibilities

Strategic Integration: Lead the university-wide integration of
the Boldly Butler Strategy's Experiential Learning for All
initiative across all colleges and academic programs.
Program Expansion: Scale existing high-impact practices—such as
internships, study away, research, and treks—to build a robust,
inclusive, and scalable experiential portfolio.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with deans, department
chairs, and faculty to align experiential opportunities with
curriculum design, modern teaching pedagogies, and academic
goals.
Infrastructure and Process Design: Develop, refine, implement,
and maintain centralized infrastructure, including operational
processes, systems, and workflows necessary to support scalable
growth and student onboarding. External Relations and Pipeline
Development: Cultivate and maintain strategic relationships with
alumni, corporate partners, non-profits, and regional entities to
expand external project placement and networking
opportunities.
Barrier Reduction: Develop and administer equitable support
initiatives to eliminate cost, travel, and structural barriers,
ensuring all students can participate in off-campus or global
programs in diverse experiences.
Data Assessment & Reporting: Establish a robust
data-informed ecosystem to track, assess, and report on the scale,
efficacy, and career-readiness impact of experiential
initiatives.
Team Management: Provide operational and professional
leadership to a dedicated team of direct reports managing
day-to-day experiential programming and operations.
Fiscal Stewardship: Manage operational budgets and carefully
allocate philanthropic gifts or grant funds to optimize
student-facing experiential programming.

Required Qualifications

Education: Master’s degree in a relevant field or
experiential-focused field. A terminal degree (Ph.D., Ed.D., J.D.)
is preferred.
Equivalent executive leadership experience and demonstrated
impact on higher education strategy may be considered in lieu of an
advanced degree.
Experience: 5+ years of progressive leadership experience
overseeing high-impact student outcomes, experiential learning
programs, career development, or strategic academic/administrative
initiatives in higher education or complex organization
settings.
Highly Organized Strategic Implementer: Translate institutional
vision into effective action by executing complex initiatives,
developing implementation plans, and anticipating operational
challenges before they arise.
Flexible Systems Thinker: Demonstrate strong systems thinking,
recognizing connections across the institution, understanding the
complexity of organizational systems, identifying opportunities for
alignment, and balancing institution-wide consistency with the
flexibility needed to meet the unique needs of individual colleges,
departments, and programs.
Relationship Management and Influence: Cultivate relationships
and build trust to facilitate cross-functional collaboration,
ensuring decisive action and forward progress when navigating
competing priorities among diverse stakeholders.
Data-Informed Decision Making: Skilled in data and assessment,
using evidence to inform decisions through data collection,
analysis, dashboard development, and institutional assessment
practices.
Exceptional Execution: Demonstrates project management and
organizational skills that enable meticulous attention to detail,
robust documentation, and rigorous follow-through.
Communication Skills: Effectively engages faculty across
colleges, academic leadership, administrative leaders, community
partners, and executive leadership, serving as a bridge between
academic and operational perspectives to ensure shared
understanding and successful implementation.

The successful candidate will demonstrate experience in:

Leading complex institutional initiatives
Project management and prioritization
Organizational change
Higher education administration
Cross-functional collaboration
Data analytics and reporting
Continuous improvement
Strategic implementation
Process design
Stakeholder engagement – internal and external
Continuous improvement mindset

Preferred Qualifications

Ph.D. or Ed.D. in a relevant field or experiential-focused
field
Established track record of utilizing donor-backed funds or
successfully implementing large-scale comprehensive campaign goals
(such as the Boldly Butler initiatives).
Deep understanding of modern assessment methodologies regarding
the scholarship of teaching and learning.
Active involvement or volunteer leadership within national
experiential education or career development associations.
Evidence of interdisciplinary data management

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
